assessments.reasoning: The publisher tag binds the specification that defines file path glob section headers and the key-value declarations applied through them.

challenge.method: Examine the file parser rules, the path-relative glob rule, and the separate preamble declaration and unset behavior.
challenge.results: The selector semantics give the notation a defined application model. Coding-style declarations belong to matching sections. The preamble stop setting has a distinct role.

limitations: The evidence applies to the v0.17.2 specification. Editor integrations and arbitrary INI parsers have separate scopes.
